notes: TBox rule edit. A well-known member's membership and its stored value are separate background facts; each world gives up one per member (the membership where the stored value wins). The core-fusion processes are individuals; 'What does it fuse?' presupposes one process per star (firm rule). q1 reads 'Is helium the fuel?' as fusing helium into carbon, and q3 'does the fusion produce helium?' as fusing hydrogen into helium (the two processes in play).
